1:# Outline — what the paper says and what carries it (revision 4: review round 1, Brief revision 5, venue budget)
3:Source: `idea-repo` Brief revision 4 (the idea, the predictions P1–P5, the study design and cell budget), the objective (`story-repo`#1) and `prior_work.md`. This page says *what to test and where it shows*, never what a result must be. Every claim below has a "refuted if" line; a result that triggers it changes the claim, and I take it to `idea-repo` (see "When results do not carry it").
6:Regression-adjustment estimators of the global average treatment effect (GATE) under network interference (Chin 2019; Han–Ugander 2023) fit outcome on functions of the assignment (own treatment, treated-neighbour fraction, …) and predict at all-treated and all-control. Published work shows they *can* work but gives no account of *how well, why, and when not*. We treat the estimator as **extrapolation from the observed exposure distribution to the two global corners** and ask what that predicts. The error splits into a **variance part** (OLS leverage of the corner contrast, scaling like d/(p(1−p)n)) and a **bias part** (curvature of the response × raw distance of the corner from the observed exposure support, roughly *not* growing with degree). The two parts have different drivers and, for the fraction feature, are predicted to move in opposite directions with degree (count, 2-hop and threshold mechanisms have their own predicted scalings), so "error grows with degree" is predicted to hold only where noise dominates. shown.message:
Outline rev 5 is pushed to the `Outline` wiki page. It follows Brief rev. 6 and the cells `analysis` settled in plan rev. 1. I made one reading of the Brief changes that you may want to check.

- **Baselines:** causal message passing is now related work only, because the study has one outcome per unit. I took this from the Brief's decision to drop it. The one-shot diffusion regression with ρ fitted is reported under its own name as the oracle-form floor. Adaptive-threshold Hájek is named as the simplified variant. The GNN arm is not run and cluster HT is not implemented. The Discussion and Methods wording now says so.
- **Cells:** the page records which of my requested additions `analysis` settled and the caveats Fig 1 must state. Examples are that mechanism (e) at s=0.9 is truncated at K=30 steps, and that `or_fit` stops at ρ=0.85. Fig 9 uses the HC0 coverage column.
- **Not changed:** C6 already carried the D-set rule from Brief rev. 5, so I left it as is.

No results exist yet, so no claim has been revised. `story-repo`#2 and `experiment-repo`#4 stay open.
